# kinsta_regions (Data Source)

Lists the data center regions the company can create sites in.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kinsta_regions" "all" {}

output "region_codes" {
  value = data.kinsta_regions.all.regions[*].region
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) Available regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Human-readable name, e.g. `Ashburn (US)`.
- `region` (String) Region code for `kinsta_site.region`, e.g. `us-ashburn-1`.
